power.capacity-scope: the load the PDU can hand on (SKU, "1.92 kW max"); it is not what the PDU draws itself, which no document held states
power.output-rating: 16 A total; 20 A 120 V NEMA 5-20R outlets

base.description: The PDU as it ships, with its fixed 15 ft cord. The 250 mm adapter from the L5-20P plug to a 5-20R is in the box and is not drawn.

description: Eaton ePDU G3 basic rack PDU, 0U. A 1524 mm metal strip with 24 NEMA 5-20R outlets in one row. It takes a single-phase 120 V feed through a fixed 15 ft cord that ends in a NEMA L5-20P (16 A, 1.92 kW). At the cord end of the face are an inner ground stud, a 20 A push-to-reset circuit breaker and a power lamp. It has no display, no switch and no network port.

gaps.note: the SKU says "0U (Vertical)" and the drawing "Mounting Vertical (0U)", but neither draws or lists a mounting button, bracket or keyhole, and the rear view shows only four screws. No mounting hardware is placed (searched: the drawing's every view, the SKU, the G3 quick start guide, which is generic).
gaps.wanted: the accessory kit the maker lists for this strip, or a rear photograph.

gaps.note: the sheet draws both sides with the ePDU and EATON logos and the outlet mouldings standing proud of the face, and dimensions none of it. The sides are drawn as plain faces with a logo-zone region.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned section through the strip, or a photograph of a side.

gaps.note: no photograph of any face is held and no document states a colour. Every colour is a stand-in (near black), unchecked against the unit.

the ground stud, the breaker and the lamp are class parts (common/ground-stud@1, common/breaker-push-reset@1, eaton/tripplite-led@1) whose size differs from the drawn feature by about 2 mm; the drawing gives no part number for any of them.
gaps.wanted: the maker's part numbers or a dimensioned detail of the cord end.

gaps.note: the SKU's weight, 0.0001 lb, is implausible and no other held document gives one, so none is stated.

outlets.mixed: the PDU's 24 NEMA 5-20R outlets, numbered 1 to 24 from the cord end as printed

name: epbz77

breaker.note: drawing and datasheet - "Over Current Protection CB/20A (UL1077)" and the face's printed "20A Circuit Breaker": one push-to-reset breaker, 18.3 across at its outer ring on the drawing. The library part is common/breaker-push-reset@1, 16.5 by 14.3 and a class stand-in with its own estimates, so the drawn ring and the part differ by about 2 and the part is declared a stand-in. The drawing states no lines: the unit is single-phase and the breaker protects all 24 outlets.

capability.note: datasheet - the SKU: "OUTLET CONTROL No"; the drawing: "Power Switch N/A". Nothing meters the unit and no outlet switches, so `metering-scope: none` and `outlet-switching: false`. The outlets state no `states`.

chassis.note: drawing - 1524 overall length (60 in, the SKU's "60 in"); the face reads 37.5 across at 300 dpi, and the SKU gives 1.5 in (38.1) for the other two axes, so the strip is modelled 38 by 38. The drawing's 38.0 by 38.0 detail beside the plug is read as the same cross-section and is not labelled as one. The SKU's weight, 0.0001 lb, is implausible and is not used. The strip's colour is not stated in any held document (the drawing's material note says only "see Note"); the face is drawn near black as the other Eaton strips are, which is unchecked.

dcim.note: the input is one power port, `nema-l5-20p`, the part's slug, and each outlet a power outlet fed by it, `nema-5-20r` (both in NetBox and Nautobot). The outlets are named as the unit prints them, 1 to 24. No `feed_leg` is written: a single-phase PDU is on whatever leg its plug is on.

front.note: drawing - the front view, x measured from the cord end and turned to y from the top (y = 1524 - x), y across from the face's left edge. Cord end to far end: two screws at 7.0 from the end (6.6 and 30.0 across); the INNER GROUND STUD, a hexagon 5.9 across, at 37.0; the cord's strain relief centred at 67.0, 21.5 along and 18.7 across; the 20 A breaker centred at 102.1; the POWER lamp at 132.3; the EATON logo from 215.3. The first outlet is centred 402.0 from the end (the drawing's 2.0 plus 400.0) and the 24 follow at 45.0 ("45.0 X 24 PCS"), the last at 1437.0, which leaves 87 to the far end, where two screws stand 7.0 from the end. The outlet faces are 27.0 square (read 27.0 to 27.4) and centred across at 19.0.

ground.note: drawing - "INNER GROUND STUD", a hexagon 5.9 across at the cord end. The part is common/ground-stud@1, whose hex nut is its own estimate and 8.1 across, so the drawn hexagon and the part differ. The drawing gives no thread; this is a stand-in and is listed as a question.

input.note: datasheet and drawing - "Input NEMA L5-20P", "Power Cord 12AWG / 3C, 15FT" (drawing); "5-20P, L5-20P" and "15 ft" (SKU). The drawing's 250 mm adapter from the L5-20P to a 5-20R is not part of the PDU and is not drawn. `input-plug` is the slug the cord exports, `nema-l5-20p`. 120 V single-phase, "16A / 120Vac" on the drawing and "100-120V", "16A", "1.92 kW max" on the SKU.

lamp.note: drawing - one lamp printed POWER, a ring 8.0 across. No colour or state is stated by any held document. It is drawn with eaton/tripplite-led@1, 6.0 across, a stand-in for the ring's size, and it carries no state vocabulary of the unit's own.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S RASTER DRAWING. The Eaton ePBZ77 technical drawing (EPBZ77-APR, 23 May 2011, sheet size A2, scale 1:2) has no text layer and no vector paths, so every figure was read off a 300 dpi render: 5.98 px per mm, from the drawing's own 215.3 dimension (the cord end to the EATON logo) and checked on the 27.0 mm outlet face (it reads 27.0 to 27.4). The drawing's own note says "all dimension for reference only". Readings are good to about 0.3 mm. The drawing is a broken view (the strip is cut between outlet 2 and outlet 16) so positions past the break come from the 45.0 pitch and the 1524 overall, not from a measurement. The drawing is drawn lying down with the cord end at the left; this model turns it so the cord end is at the foot, as the library's other 0U PDUs stand, and the sheet does not say which end is up. No photograph of any face is held: colours, finish and the shape of every part that stands proud of the face are unchecked.

mount.note: `rack-side`, as the library's other zero-U strips, `ru: 35` from 1524 / 44.45 = 34.3 rounded up. The SKU says "0U (Vertical)" and the drawing "Mounting Vertical (0U)". NO MOUNTING HARDWARE IS DRAWN OR LISTED: the back view shows four screws and no button, bracket or keyhole (gaps: mounting).

outlets.note: drawing - "NEMA 5-20R x 24", "20A 120V NEMA 5-20R SINGLE TYPE 24 PCS", numbered from 1, outlet 1 the one nearest the cord. The drawing draws each with the T slot toward the cord end and the earth hole toward the face's right when the strip is turned as here. Numerals read 1, 2, 16, 17 and 18 on the sheet; the rest follow the same rule. The legend "16A Max" is printed beside outlet 1. The last outlet label the drawing shows is 18 and it states 24 outlets (the break hides 3 to 15 and 19 to 24).

rear.note: drawing - the first view of the sheet, a plain plate with a screw 7.0 from each end at 5.5 and 31.1 across, read from the 70 dpi view of the sheet's top strip. Nothing else is drawn on it.

sides.note: drawing - the sheet draws both sides, with the "ePDU" and EATON logos and the outlet mouldings standing off the face. No figure gives the logos' size or how far the mouldings stand, so neither is drawn and each side carries a logo-zone region (gaps: side-features).

bottom.empty: no source draws the cord end as a face: the drawing's detail beside the plug shows a 38.0 by 38.0 section with the cord leaving it, which is not a view of the end.

placements.description: the 20 A push-to-reset circuit breaker (UL1077) that protects all 24 outlets

regions.label: EATON logo, from 215.3 to about 260 from the cord end; not drawn

left.empty: the drawing draws this side as the other one mirrored, with its logos and the mouldings standing proud, and no figure dimensions them (gaps: side-features); the logos are not drawn.

right.empty: the drawing draws the side with its logos and the outlet mouldings standing proud, and no figure dimensions them (gaps: side-features); the ePDU and EATON logos are not drawn.

top.empty: no source draws the end: the drawing's end detail shows the cord's section and no face of the far end, and the SKU has no picture of it.
